name: FXNewsBias API
description:
Sentiment scores for the 8 majors, refreshed every 3 hours, plus the settled session bias scorecard. Gold (XAU/USD) is served on its own Pro-only Markets endpoints under `/api/v1/markets`, so the sentiment endpoint keeps exactly 8 rows.

The `/v1` response shapes are frozen: nothing on this path changes shape or meaning. Additive OPTIONAL fields are permitted, breaking changes get a `/v2` path. The authoritative contract is https://fxnewsbias.com/developers.

Every response carries an `attribution` object. Consumers displaying or republishing the data must keep it.
